title: Skiing Downhill
seo_title: Skiing Downhill — Play Free Ski Game Online
meta_desc: Play Skiing Downhill free online. Ski down snowy mountains, jump the rocks and keep your run alive in this quick browser winter sports game.
desc: Skiing Downhill asks one thing: can you read a mountain? Ski the snowy slopes, jump the rocks that block your line, and keep the descent going as long as your legs hold.
howto: Click or press Space to jump rocks.
Time each jump — late jumps clip the rock.
Keep your run alive to grow the score.
The descent speeds up the longer you last.
tips: Jump the moment a rock enters your line of sight.
Do not spam jumps — mistimed hops land on rocks.
Stay relaxed: the pace rises gradually, not suddenly.
